sections.label: FEATURES
sections.title: Everything you need to stay on schedule.

items.title: Today, in order
items.text: Every dose due today in time order, how many are left and what's next. Tap a dose when you take it.

items.title: Add it in a sentence
items.text: Type "Lisinopril 10 mg every morning" and the dose, schedule and times are filled in. Once to four times a day, every other day, weekly or as needed.

items.title: Reminders with buttons
items.text: A reminder at each dose time with Taken, Snooze and Skip right on it. Doses you've already taken don't get one, and times stay put when you travel.

items.title: Refill reminders
items.text: Each dose counts one down. Get a reminder at the number you choose, with your pharmacy's number at hand.

items.title: Apple Watch
items.text: See today's doses on your wrist and mark them taken or skipped. Record an as-needed dose in a tap.

items.title: Completely private
items.text: No account, no analytics, no tracking. Your medications stay on your iPhone and Apple Watch.

sections.label: PRIVACY
sections.title: Your meds. Your data.
text: Medication data is deeply personal. Meds Easy keeps everything on your device: no HealthKit, no cloud, no analytics. It reminds you of the schedule you enter and doesn't replace your doctor or pharmacist.

cta.title: Stay on schedule.
cta.text: Free on the App Store. No account required.
